canonical_project: Centrul de Date Regional Sud-Muntenia (Dambovita participation)
owner: Serviciul de Telecomunicatii Speciale (STS) with Dambovita County Council among partners
notes: Dambovita County Council is an official partner (with Arges, Calarasi, Giurgiu, Ialomita, Prahova, Teleorman and STS) in the South-Muntenia Regional Data Center project (SMIS 342697, PR SM 2021-2027, total budget 236.4 million lei, Jul 2025 - Dec 2028). The data center facility itself is to be built in Ploiesti, Prahova county; no standalone data center found in Targoviste or elsewhere in Dambovita.
